image_description: A full-body shot of a Blenheim spaniel standing in profile on a green grass lawn. The dog has a white coat with rich chestnut/red patches, particularly on the ears and head. It features long, heavily feathered ears, a domed head, and a docked tail held level with the back. The image has a decorative brown border frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is domed with short upturned nose and well-defined stop.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head shape clearly shows the characteristic dome (apple-head) and the muzzle is short with a visible stop. The nose appears short and slightly upturned.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are large, round, dark, and set wide apart.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eyes are dark, round, and appear large relative to the head size, consistent with the breed standard.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ears are long, set low, and heavily feathered with long fringe.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The ears are very long, extending well past the jawline, set low on the skull, and show significant wavy/feathered texture.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rich red-and-white parti-color coat with clearly defined red patches on white ground.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coat pattern is distinctly parti-colored with clear boundaries between the white body and the chestnut/red markings on the head, ears, and body spots.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Coat is long, silky, and straight with moderate feathering on ears, chest, legs, and tail.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The texture appears soft and silky rather than wiry. Feathering is visible on the back of the front legs, hindquarters, and tail.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is compact and cobby with short back of small toy-spaniel proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dog's torso is short and deep, fitting the 'cobby' description typical of toy spaniels.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Legs are straight with fine bone and feathered hindquarters.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The front legs appear straight and slender (fine bone). The hind legs show the required feathering.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is docked and carried level with back, well-feathered.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is visibly shorter than a natural full-length tail (docked) and is held horizontally, aligned with the topline. It has feathering.
This is a static image; gait (movement quality) cannot be evaluated.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The grass texture is somewhat uniform and repetitive, lacking the random variation of real grass, suggesting a generated or heavily filtered background.
The contact points between the paws and the grass are slightly soft and indistinct, with minor blending of the white fur into the green background, typical of AI generation.
The rear left paw is partially obscured and lacks clear definition of individual toes or structure, appearing slightly melted into the grass/shadow.
